note: The 'Yā hanānā' line frames the piece — repeated 4x at the opening/close and again after verses 1-2, per the ×٤/×٢ marks in the source.

verses.ar:
يَا هَنَانَا يَا هَنَانَا (4)
ظَهَرَ الدِّينُ الْمُؤَيَّدْ
بِظُهُورِ النَّبِيِّ أَحْمَدْ (2)
يَا هَنَانَا بِمُحَمَّدْ
ذَلِكَ الْفَضْلُ مِنَ اللّٰهِ
يَا هَنَانَا يَا هَنَانَا (4)
verses.tr:
Yā hanānā yā hanānā (4)
Ẓahara-d-dīnu-l-muʾayyad
Bi-ẓuhūri-n-Nabiyyi Aḥmad (2)
Yā hanānā bi-Muḥammad
Dhālika-l-faḍlu mina-llāh
Yā hanānā yā hanānā (4)
verses.en: O our joy, O our joy — the upheld religion has appeared with the appearance of the Prophet Ahmad; O our joy in Muhammad, that is the bounty from Allah. O our joy, O our joy.

verses.ar:
خُصَّ بِالسَّبْعِ الْمَثَانِي
وَحَوَى لُطْفَ الْمَعَانِي
مَا لَهُ فِي الْخَلْقِ ثَانِي
وَعَلَيْهِ أَنْزَلَ اللّٰهُ
يَا هَنَانَا يَا هَنَانَا
verses.tr:
Khuṣṣa bi-s-sabʿi-l-mathānī
Wa ḥawā luṭfa-l-maʿānī
Mā lahu fi-l-khalqi thānī
Wa ʿalayhi anzala-llāh
Yā hanānā yā hanānā
verses.en: He alone was given the seven oft-repeated verses, and he encompassed every subtlety of meaning; none among creation is his equal, and upon him Allah sent down revelation. O our joy, O our joy.

verses.ar:
مِنْ مَكَّةَ لَمَّا ظَهَرْ
لِأَجْلِهِ انْشَقَّ الْقَمَرْ
وَافْتَخَرَتْ آلُ مُضَرْ
بِهِ عَلَى كُلِّ الْأَنَامِ
verses.tr:
Min Makkata lammā ẓahar
Li-ajlihi-nshaqqa-l-qamar
Wa-ftakharat Ālu Muḍar
Bihi ʿalā kulli-l-anām
verses.en: When he appeared from Mecca, the moon split for his sake, and the family of Mudar took pride in him above all humankind.

verses.ar:
صَلُّوا عَلَى خَيْرِ الْأَنَامِ
الْمُصْطَفَى بَدْرِ التَّمَامِ
صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا
يَشْفَعْ لَنَا يَوْمَ الزِّحَامِ
verses.tr:
Ṣallū ʿalā khayri-l-anām
Al-Muṣṭafā badri-t-tamām
Ṣallū ʿalayhi wa sallimū
Yashfaʿ lanā yawma-z-ziḥām
verses.en: Send blessings upon the best of creation, the Chosen One, the moon at its fullness; send blessings and peace upon him — he will intercede for us on the day of the crowded gathering.
